2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch adds a test to the Linux kernel selftests suite to verify that the MADV_PAGEOUT functionality works correctly. Specifically, it checks that an owner of a read-only file can evict a clean page from the file, and that unauthorized callers cannot evict pages from shared files or private mappings. The test runs as an unprivileged user, even when started as root, to ensure that capabilities do not interfere with ownership. Additionally, the patch includes code to map temporary files with specific permissions and to drop privileges for the test.
